title: P4 Capture integration
human_intent: Use Prometeo anywhere as a page-scoped durable note/work memory: typed notes, private audio with automatic recoverable transcription, files, AI-derived guidance, disposable thinking sessions and one-click execution of every unworked instruction without depending on old chats.
already_decided: shared/capture/v1 remains the single Capture owner; do not add a second global recorder or page-local authority.
The active recorder expands to explicit pause/resume/save/discard controls; it does not need to remain tiny while recording.
Audio is local-first, then privately uploaded; transcription may be recovered by another linked Prometeo device and must not remain an opaque pending item forever.
Pensar is an interactive disposable design/research chat and does not execute by default.
Guardar distills a Pensar session into an AI_DERIVED page note plus durable continuity; old ChatGPT transcripts are not required for recovery.
Trabajar automatically selects the current unworked notes, AI-derived notes and files since the last successful result; the button click is the explicit human action.
Private audio, transcripts, session capabilities and note payloads never belong in GitHub/public coordination.
Current, Human Accepted and Served remain separate authorities; this software release does not fabricate Human Acceptance.
ref_convention: Read the current main workstream return first; product/runtime source is now integrated on main and served from gh-pages.
high_value_targets: Treat the Anywhere Notes v3 software frontier as shipped; do not rebuild the old P4 candidate/canary architecture.
Collect physical phone/browser evidence only when useful and record actual user feedback as a new delta rather than blocking the shipped software state.
Continue improving transcription/device recovery and Think/Work ergonomics only from observed failures or new user intent.
known_failures: Competing global shell injectors previously caused served drift; keep one Universal Control.
A Work click immediately after saving audio previously raced the upload; current launch waits for the in-flight save.
Save capabilities must never appear in query strings; Guardar fallback uses a URL fragment and strips it from browser history before POST.
Private transcripts must not become publicly enumerable context.
Do not infer Human Accepted merely because CI and live-byte publication are green.
